purpose: Summative evidence for B2.9 (scale up ratios 1:2, 1:5, 1:10).
student_learning_goal: I can use ratios 1:2, 1:5, and 1:10 to scale up amounts and solve real-life problems.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can use ratios 1:2, 1:5, and 1:10 to scale up amounts and solve real-life problems.
header.character_watermark: Tony, Maya, and Pixel together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Fill in the scaled-up rows for each ratio.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Three ratio tables stacked.

image_placeholders.description: Three ratio tables in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each ~7in × 1.8in. Table 1 — 1:2 ratio with rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 10 (fill in the second column). Table 2 — 1:5 ratio with rows 1, 2, 4, 6, 8. Table 3 — 1:10 ratio with rows 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.
image_placeholders.placement: Top of the page; three tables stacked.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_THREE_TABLES: keywords (ratio, table) name what the tables show.

parts.student_instructions: Solve each problem using the appropriate ratio.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Six scenario boxes in a 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Six scenario boxes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 3-column grid. Each ~2.5in × 1.8in. Scenarios: S1 'Pancake recipe is 1:2 flour:milk. 4 cups flour = ? milk.' S2 '1 toonie = 2 dollars. 6 toonies = ? dollars.' S3 '1 dime = 10 pennies. 4 dimes = ?' S4 '1 nickel = 5 pennies. 7 nickels = ?' S5 '1 km = 1000m. 3 km = ?' S6 '1 dozen = 12 eggs. 5 dozen = ?'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_SIX_SCENARIOS: keywords (scenario, ratio) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: S1: 4×2=8 cups milk. S2: 6×2=12 dollars. S3: 4×10=40 pennies. S4: 7×5=35 pennies. S5: 3×1000=3000 m. S6: 5×12=60 eggs.

parts.student_instructions: Pick a 1:2, 1:5, or 1:10 ratio from real life. Write 3 scaled-up examples.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. A blank box.

image_placeholders.description: A blank rectangular box in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2in, with light-grey solid outline. Maya thinking-bubble icon in the top-right corner.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_MY_RATIO_BOX: keywords (ratio, examples) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept e.g., 'Ratio: 1 dog to 2 dog treats. Scaled: 3 dogs need 6 treats; 5 dogs need 10 treats; 10 dogs need 20 treats.'

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a 1:3 ratio (a stretch beyond what we covered) and scale it up.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use Parts 1-3 as summative evidence for B2.9. Watch for additive scale-up errors in Part 1.
